items.q: Carlton Van Vechten, Jimmy Daniels, Lilya Walker, Henry Branham, those were the people that Carl came around.

ctx.x: Yeah, Carlton Van Vechten, Jimmy Daniels, Lilya Walker, Henry Branham, those were the people that Carl came around. That was the big -- supposed to be the high class ones. See, high class people. But now he -- Carlton Van Vechten liked both. He liked Bessie for her lowness, although he was a fine guy, and his wife was just as sweet, you know. They were fine people. But he liked both. He didn't try to, you know, make one feel bad. But we never associated with Bessie, although she was human. But she was just a…
But it was strange, because Porter Granger was a very elegant --
